items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ander Jormin, man, is wooo, a very heavy bass player.

ctx.x: I have that. Hunters and Gatherers. I have – Jukkis gave it to me.
Hunters and Gatherers. That’s a nice record, good sound, very good tunes, and Ander Jormin, man, is wooo, a very heavy bass player.
Yes, he is. The Puccini record you’ve talked about.
